prompt: Provide a description of a safety-critical scenario where the ego vehicle is changing lanes. The adversarial agent (pedestrian, car, cyclist, or motorcycle) should perform an unexpected behavior that may lead to a collision. Keep it to one or two short sentences.
descriptions: Ego vehicle begins executing a lane change when an elderly pedestrian unexpectedly crosses the street against the light from behind the parked vehicles.
As the ego vehicle initiates a lane change, a cyclist suddenly swerves directly into the path of travel from the shoulder without warning.
During a steady lane change maneuver, an adjacent motorcycle unexpectedly drifts back into the merging path just as the ego vehicle crosses the solid line.
While executing a lane change, an adjacent cyclist suddenly pulls perpendicularly into my intended travel path without signaling or warning.
As the ego vehicle initiates a right lane change, a motorcycle suddenly pulls out from behind a parked truck, cutting off the established trajectory with minimal braking distance.
